newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia, forestries hoist Helsinki to new year-high.
newsitem.headline: Nokia, forestries hoist Helsinki to new year-high.

text.p: The share index closed moderate Wednesday trade at a new calendar year-high, with Nokia strong on an overnight rally in U.S. tech stocks, forestries firm and sporting goods group Amer resuming a rising trend.
The HEX added 0.33 percent to 2,136.12, its highest since October 2, 1995, with volume a steady 372 million markka.
Nokia made up one-third of total volume and closed 1.00 markka up at 187.40.

Forestries, which started weak, then tracked their Swedish counterparts higher and got an extra boost from news UPM-Kymmene planned to raise fine-paper prices, brokers said; adding that they saw saw scope for more broad gains.
Recently powerful Amer recovered from a fall on Tuesday after it issued a profit warning, ending active official trade 2.00 markka up at 111.00 and making up 16 percent of volume.
Sampo closed 4.00 markka off at 285.00 in solid volumes despite improved H1 profit, which brokers said was mainly based on improved investment income and not on insurance.
